Container.Name: claude-code
Container.Overview: Autonomous Claude Code agent, unRAID managed.

Config.Name: Agent home
Config.Description: Persists .claude auth, agents, settings

Config.Name: Projects
Config.Description: Working area for repositories the agent may edit

Config.Name: Secrets
Config.Description: Read only secrets, for example the HA token file

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Lets the agent control other containers. High privilege.

Config.Name: HA base URL
Config.Description: Home Assistant API base

Config.Name: Claude Code OAuth Token
Config.Description: Long-lived OAuth token from claude setup-token, used instead of the interactive OAuth session which can expire without refreshing.

Config.Name: Host boot (unraid-ops)
Config.Description: OPTIONAL, empty = not mounted. Set to /boot to mount the unRAID flash drive READ-WRITE. Edits made through this mount are permanent on the flash drive and survive reboots: a bad edit to User Scripts, dockerMan templates or config can stop the array or Docker starting. Only for unraid-ops host work; omit it otherwise.

Config.Name: Host mnt (unraid-ops)
Config.Description: OPTIONAL, empty = not mounted. Set to /mnt to read host appdata and shares READ-ONLY, so host files can be inspected without starting a throwaway container. Read-only: writes fail by design. Exposes every share to anything running in this container.

Config.Name: Claude Custom MCP Connector Port
Config.Description: claude-code-connector MCP endpoint at http://[IP]:8765/mcp

Config.Name: Claude Custom MCP Connector Token
Config.Description: Bearer token for the MCP connector (AUTH_MODE bearer or both). With the default bearer mode, leave empty to disable the connector.

Config.Name: Connector Auth Mode
Config.Description: MCP connector auth: bearer (CONNECTOR_TOKEN), access (Cloudflare Access JWT) or both. The connector only starts with a complete config for the chosen mode.

Config.Name: Connector Access Team Domain
Config.Description: Cloudflare Access team domain, e.g. team.cloudflareaccess.com. Only for AUTH_MODE access or both.

Config.Name: Connector Access AUD
Config.Description: Cloudflare Access application audience tag. Only for AUTH_MODE access or both.

Config.Name: Connector Access Allowed Emails
Config.Description: Comma-separated emails allowed through Access. REQUIRED for AUTH_MODE access or both; the connector refuses to start with it empty.

Config.Name: Claude Usage Collector Port
Config.Description: claude-usage-collector JSON endpoint at http://[IP]:8766/usage, for the macOS usage widget. Serves usage percentages and spend figures only — never a credential.

Config.Name: Claude Usage Collector Token
Config.Description: Optional bearer token for the usage collector. Leave empty to serve it unauthenticated on the LAN.

Config.Name: Remote Control Projects
Config.Description: Which /projects subdirectories auto-launch Remote Control at startup. Leave empty for all CLAUDE.md projects (default), 'none' for none, or a space-separated list of project names.

Config.Name: AWS Bedrock API Key
Config.Description: AWS Bedrock API key for the PAL MCP code-review advisor (ap-southeast-2). Leave empty to disable PAL's model calls.

Config.Name: OpenRouter API Key
Config.Description: OpenRouter API key for the PAL MCP frontier advisor (GPT-6.1 Terra). Leave empty to disable OpenRouter routing.

Config.Name: OpenRouter Models Config Path
Config.Description: Path to the OpenRouter model registry on the persisted mount. PAL's bundled registry stops at gpt-5.2 and cannot resolve gpt-5.6 or gpt-6.1.

Config.Name: OpenRouter Allowed Models
Config.Description: Comma-separated allowlist restricting which OpenRouter models PAL may call. Cost guardrail. GPT-6.1 Terra is the counsel; GPT-5.6 Terra is kept as a fallback.

Config.Name: Connector Job Timeout (ms)
Config.Description: How long a connector job may run before it is hard-killed with SIGKILL, in MILLISECONDS (1800000 = 30 minutes). Applies when a caller omits timeout_seconds. Raise for long image builds; note this is milliseconds, not seconds.
